actors.name: Matteo Salvini
actors.blurb: Salvini remains a central figure in European right-wing politics, though his leadership of the Lega party is increasingly contested. Internal divisions within the party, particularly from northern leaders like Attilio Fontana and Massimiliano Romeo, have intensified, with calls for his resignation or a shift in party strategy. Salvini's focus on migration and regional autonomy continues to drive coverage, but his declining popularity and the rise of figures like Roberto Vannacci have weakened his influence. His leadership will be tested in the upcoming Pontida rally and potential electoral alliances.

His role in the RN's electoral strategy and potential alliances remains a key focus of media coverage.
